parsed.reply: «La balsa» is moderately common, though mostly when you are talking about rivers, crossing water where there is no bridge, or emergency situations at sea. You will also hear it in Latin America for a floating mass of logs or vegetation.
followUps: Give me an example of the floating mass
How does it differ from bote?
